title: Tilt-energy inequality for a general cut-off (Simon 5.2.1 before choosing ζ)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set, R = (M, θ, ξ_R) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M, W ⊆ U any set, κ ∈ ℝ, and H : ℝ^P → ℝ^P μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x, such that R.firstVariation X = −∫⟨X, H⟩dμ for every C¹ compactly supported X : ℝ^P → ℝ^P with tsupport X ⊆ W. Assume x ↦ p_x is μ-a.e. strongly measurable, where p_x is the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x. Let S ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim S = n, ξ ∈ ℝ^P, and ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ a C¹ function with compact support and tsupport ζ ⊆ W. With w(x) := (x − ξ) − p_S(x − ξ) and |p_x − p_S|² := Σ_i |p_x e_i − p_S e_i|² (e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1), the lower Lebesgue integrals satisfy ∫⁻ ofReal(ζ(x)²|p_x − p_S|²) dμ ≤ ofReal(16)·∫⁻ ofReal(‖Dζ(x)‖²|w(x)|²) dμ + ofReal(4)·∫⁻ ofReal(κ ζ(x)² |w(x)|) dμ, where Dζ(x) = fderiv ℝ ζ x and ‖·‖ is the operator norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P) (κ : ℝ) (S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P) (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ), W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → Module.finrank ℝ S = n → ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (ζ x ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin P, ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 16 * ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ ζ x‖ ^ 2 * ‖(x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure + ENNReal.ofReal 4 * ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (κ * ζ x ^ 2 * ‖(x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)‖) ∂R.measure
